court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Petitioner(s): Mr. M.S. Akash Daniel
For Respondent(s): Mr. R.P. Murugan Raja Govt Advocate
judgment_text:
PRAYER directing the 1st respondent to consider petitioner's representation dated 11.12.2025 and to survey and sub divide the property situated at Survey Nos. 147/15 and 149/13 Kudikadu Village, Cuddalore Taluk and Cuddalore District and issue separate patta for the land lawfully belonging to the petitioner within the specified time.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— This writ petition has been filed to direct the first respondent to survey and sub divide the lands, morefully described in the prayer to this writ petition and for issuance of separate patta in the name of the petitioner, based on the petitioner's representation dated 11.12.2025, within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.

2. The petitioner claims that he is the owner of the property, morefully described in the prayer to this writ petition. He has given a representation to the respondents seeking for survey and sub divide the lands, morefully described in the prayer to this writ petition on 11.12.2025. The petitioner has filed supporting documents along with this writ petition in support of his representation seeking for survey and subdivision of the property, morefully disclosed in the prayer to this writ petition and also for issuance of patta in his name for the said property. Since the same have not been considered till date, the petitioner has filed this writ petition.

3. Mr. R.P. Murugan Raja, learned Government Advocate accepts notice on behalf of the respondents.

4. This Court is not expressing any opinion on the merits of the petitioner's representation.

5. No prejudice will be caused to the respondents if the said authorities are directed to consider the representation dated 11.12.2025, submitted by the petitioner seeking for survey and sub division of the lands, morefully described in the prayer to this writ petition and also for issuance of separate patta, on merits and in accordance with law, after hearing the objections if any from the neighbouring land owners as well as any other party whom they deem it fit to enquire, within a time frame to be fixed by this Court.

6. For the foregoing reasons, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the first respondent to pass final orders, on merits and in accordance with law on the petitioner's representation dated 11.12.2025 seeking for survey and sub division of the property, morefully described in the prayer to this writ petition and for issuance of separate patta in his name, after giving due consideration to the supporting documents filed by the petitioner and after hearing the objections if any from the neighbouring land owners as well as any other party whom they deem it fit to enquire, within a period of 12 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. No Costs.
